title: Builder's Void Repair
description: Fixes a texture display issue with the Void Pearl and Linked Void Pearl.
body:
### Eng:
Users of the Builder's Void mod may have encountered texture display issues.
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e2a04ea1a613c4f5c7a8f9b8bca5aef47e4d357.png)
This texture pack will fix this issue.
![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7eee0e94da7ea283322950fc65d521024f4c684.png)
### Ru:
Пользователи мода Builder's Void могли столкнуться с проблемами отображения текстур.
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e2a04ea1a613c4f5c7a8f9b8bca5aef47e4d357.png)
Этот пакет текстур исправит эту проблему.
![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7eee0e94da7ea283322950fc65d521024f4c684.png)
